faq.bookingsQ: How do I reschedule or cancel?
faq.bookingsA: Open the booking from your Bookings tab — you can adjust the timing, switch between video and home visit, or cancel. We confirm everything before anything changes.
faq.paymentsQ: How do payments and refunds work?
faq.paymentsA: You always see the offering amount before you confirm. If plans change, refunds follow the timing shared on each ritual — no surprises.
faq.panditsA: Every pandit ji is verified for tradition and care. We match you by ritual, language, and the moment you’re marking.
faq.privacyA: We keep only what’s needed to serve your rituals. Saved rituals stay on your device until you book.

help.contactBody: Our team replies with the same calm you came for.
